instruction: The interface `com.fasterxml.jackson.core.util.BufferRecyclerPool` is about to be used for pooling more than buffer recyclers, so its name is too narrow. Rename the type `BufferRecyclerPool` to `RecyclerPool` (same package, and rename its source file accordingly). The rename must cover the type declaration, every import, and every use of the type (including qualified references to its nested types), in main code and tests. Do not rename fields, methods or other types whose names merely contain `BufferRecyclerPool` (for example `_bufferRecyclerPool`, `bufferRecyclerPool()`, `setBufferRecyclerPool`, or test class names). Behavior must not change: the project must still build and its tests must pass.
